scientific limitations/integrity: General fixed-forest enumeration in complete bipartite and complete multipartite graphs is prior literature, including a 2026 arbitrary-forest determinant formula. The new claim is deliberately restricted to the matching-specific transfer-current collapse for arbitrary part count and the resulting joint-inclusion, covariance, and Poisson-binomial intersection law. Targeted literature and semantic-result searches found no equivalent distributional statement, but this is a best-of-knowledge originality assessment. Exact Matrix-Tree and brute-force checks cover 394 joint-inclusion cases on all multipartite types through order 8 and 89 full-distribution cases through order 6. No independent audit, formal proof, or expert attestation has been performed.
title: Poisson-binomial matching intersections in complete-multipartite uniform spanning trees
